question: Into how many parts must the breadth of the sun floor be divided?
premises: The breadth of the sun floor is under consideration.
The breadth is to be divided.
The division is into sun parts.
inference: The breadth of the sun floor is to be divided into sun parts.
uncertainties: Bhānubhāga conventionally indicates twelve parts but is not explicit here.
plain_english: When the breadth of the sun floor is divided into sun parts.
